overview: The Cracked Plain is the most unstable geomantic zone in Marus Seru.
details: Massive fissures split the plateau, crystal fractures pulse with resonance, and stone creature swarms migrate unpredictably.
hooks: A new fissure opens, revealing a deep geomantic chamber.
Stone creature swarms surge toward the Central Expanse.
Crystal fractures emit dangerous resonance pulses.
A Seru patrol is trapped on a collapsing shelf.
Geomantic readings spike beyond known thresholds.
